task: Troubleshoot an ABB XT7 breaker whose hardwired closed-feedback relay is not reporting while the HMI shows Closed.

command: Read Tmax UDT v1_0_1 Status folder and CB-A1 instance
purpose: Find which signal drives the HMI Closed state

output: BKRSTS = Ekip Modbus IRUS40.0. BKRSTSWPLC = BKRSTS while COMMSTS Connected and quality good; falls back to PLC {MDC}/EPMS-01/Crusoe/SNY/{MDC}/Diagnostics/PLC/Marshalling/{InstanceName}/Breaker_Closed only on comms loss. HMI Closed comes from the trip unit, which masks a dead hardwired aux contact.
